text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days earlier, at a scrimmage with Tracen Academy's most elite…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And Daiwa Scarlet grabs an overwhelming victory! No one could catch up with her after the fourth corner!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Obviously. I can't be satisfied if I'm not number one in everything…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That means number one in speed, stamina, competitiveness, and heart! You better be ready, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer… She's crazy. She's seriously aiming to be number one in everything.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I dunno what kinda training she's been doin', but it's clearly working.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, Trainer. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka! Looks like you didn't run away today!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Tell me honestly. What do you think? You want to win against me so badly it hurts, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I wanna win. You were all talk back in spring… but you're different now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What the heck happened to push you so far?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You. You're the one who's been pushing me. I'm not gonna let you leave me behind.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You frustrated me! You opened my eyes! You made me this serious!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And now, the number one person I want to win against… is you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I saw your determination when you threw away everything to enter the Derby, and do you know what I thought?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I wanted to run against you! I didn't wanna lose to you! I didn't want to be left behind—never again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to use everything I have to beat you at your absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's why I've been training. I've put in more effort than anyone else to get here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I dedicated my entire summer for this. That's why I'm going to be the number one center of attention this fall!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, is that right? You're not the same Scarlet I used to know anymore.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Looks like you've found your own answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sparks fly between them. It looks like the Shuka Sho is going to be stormy, contrary to the tranquil autumn weather.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right. Let's see what you got.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You saw my determination at the Derby. Now it's your turn to show me yours, Scarlet!
